Bea: hypothetically, if models were roommates, whod leave passive-aggressive sticky notes? :postit:
Omar: Mistral leaves 7 sticky notes, one is a riddle. it also eats your labeled yogurt. :raccoon:
Kofi: Llama2 leaves a chore spreadsheet and color-codes it. also apologizes with cookies. :cookie:
Jules: Falcon leaves a single cryptic emoji and a perfect bugfix. polite but distant. :cat:
Bea: tiny contest: write a 1-line sticky note from your model-roommate. winner gets a sticker.
Omar: my note:
```
Do not open fridge. I cached something in there. - Mistral
```
Kofi: my note: "Refilled coffee. Please do not evict cache. - Llama2"
Jules: vote: :raccoon: Mistral chaos, :dog2: Llama2 helpful, :cat: Falcon aloof
Bea: @lunchbot add "Model Roommate Sticky Note" workshop to calendar?
lunchbot: Heads up — workshop approved for next Tuesday. Catering: pastries. Budget owner: @PeopleOps."
